intent: Bind pre-existing universal interoperability, CoNav intent-first discovery, open-source donor ecology and multi-substrate replacement seams without creating a competing control plane

existing_evidence.role: translation graph across software, devices, institutional and other substrates
stable WorkID, many receiver lenses, interop transport examples
provider-neutral, capability and authorization bounded adapters
eight license-labelled reference donors, no automatic ingestion
human/machine public atlas and independent mirror design
separate public commons and commercial rights/contracting

examples_from_existing_source: Git source and immutable public manifest
adapters.rule: Interfaces translate typed capabilities and events while preserving source, permission and loss semantics; transport discovery never authorizes execution
adapters.more_than_protocol: Human/AI experience should be intent-first via existing CoNav/CoOrbWare/CoBar projections rather than an API-specific product catalogue

upstream_selection.when: Function, licensing, cost, privacy and maintenance already meet needs
upstream_selection.requires: exact upstream, version, license and security review

upstream_selection.when: Existing tool works but needs standard typed capability, source or permission mapping

upstream_selection.requires: contribution rules, rights and verified tests
legal rights, notices, attribution, marks/trademarks, update path and comparative tests

upstream_selection.when: A capability gap or genuine licence/business incompatibility warrants a substitute
upstream_selection.requires: independent specification and legal diligence; no unlicensed code copy

upstream_selection.when: Security, privacy, licence, upkeep or actual benefit fail
upstream_selection.requires: explicit replacement and rollback, no stale PASS

licensing_boundary.rule: Open source enables permitted use and commercial activity under specific conditions; licence obligations vary with combining, modifying, conveying and possibly network use; rebuilding is not automatic legal requirement
licensing_boundary.licensed_pattern_rule: A public idea or protocol may be usable independently; copyright, patents, trademarks and contractual terms must be analysed for exact implementation

conformance_candidates: One source-bound public-safe WorkID gives the same identity, evidence class and permission ceiling through offline JSON and human page
Two different adapters reconstitute the same harmless task with explicit translation-loss ledger
Revoked capability or missing legal authority fails closed with no outward action
Duplicate event replay yields one safe external effect only after fenced authorized receiver verification
One donor update changes a pinned upstream version: CI blocks silent adoption, records diff, licence and retest
Two independent failure-domain readers retrieve identical signed/hash-checked public release and cold-restore without primary provider

link_to_public_atlas.mode: A single common machine-discoverable contract; each site presents a few audience-relevant intentions and an accessible index, not every module
link_to_public_atlas.current_blocker: copolitic.org HTTP 404 and copolitic.com TLS hostname failure from X2 on 2026-11-23
link_to_public_atlas.no_inference: Site indexes and available GitHub source do not prove AI crawler intake, model-provider adoption, independent replica, or first-user outcome

next_bounded_proof: Reuse one existing RepoZipper offline synthetic fixture and CoNav source object as cross-surface input; compare JSON, browser-local demonstration and a second bounded adapter under same authority ceiling; only after CI and independent receiver proof consider a public-facing connector catalog
